WITH rng AS (
  SELECT MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_period) np, MIN(fiscal_period) p0, MAX(fiscal_period) p1
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter=1
),
sl AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f, rng WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN rng.d0 AND rng.d1
)
SELECT (SELECT d0 FROM rng) d0, (SELECT d1 FROM rng) d1, (SELECT np FROM rng) np,
  (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) maxdate,
  COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rcpt_line,
  MIN(etl_loaded_at) min_etl, MAX(etl_loaded_at) max_etl, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) n_etl,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line) ret_all,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) ret_dist_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY ALL HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) ret_dup_content,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan_returns
FROM sl

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, p.category AS cat_wasat, p.subcategory AS sub_wasat, cp.category, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_ret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.category, l.subcategory, l.cat_wasat, l.sub_wasat,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.qty_ret > l.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_returned,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.net_amount <= 0 OR l.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE l.category = 'Garden' OR l.cat_wasat = 'Garden'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH g AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.vat_rate, f.store_key, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1 AND cp.category='Garden' AND cp.subcategory<>'Outdoor Lighting' AND s.store_id<>999
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) n_ret, COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) n_ret_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date < g.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret_before_sale,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date > g.sale_date + 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret_after_45d,
  MAX(r.return_date - g.sale_date) max_lag,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > g.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refund_gt_line,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.vat_rate <> g.vat_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_ret_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g WHERE store_id=900) web_sold_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) all_lines,
  (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM g WHERE store_id=900) web_sold_net
FROM g JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id

SELECT w.status, COUNT(*) n_lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) n_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lines_with_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1 AND cp.category='Garden' AND cp.subcategory<>'Outdoor Lighting' AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
